phase_name: Migrate Gates 9-23 and Generalize the Selection Surface

objectives.description: Migrate gates 9-23 onto the registry (wrap each in gateN_run(), move the single execution loop after all gate definitions, add 15 rows to gate-registry.data) and delete the remaining copy-pasted top-level inline blocks
Preserve --skip-slow and --only-gate semantics exactly, including the zero-check-under-filter exit-2 condition
Add selection by cost class (--max-cost free|moderate|slow), resolved from gate-registry.data's cost_class field, intersecting with --only-gate when both are given (order-independent)
Keep deployed-vs-source-store dual-mode discovery intact and covered by test
Re-verify each of deploy_findings_snapshot's five callers against the migrated aggregator
Explicitly confirm a pre/post baseline comparison cannot be skewed by a one-sided noise row
Capture the complete battery's output before and after with an explicit source-store TARGET; identical finding sets and exit code; baseline the three known pre-existing failures
Add cost-class selection and dual-mode discovery test cases (test-gate-registry-resolution.sh case1 updated to 1-23; test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh cases i-m added for --max-cost)

approaches_tried.approach: Line-based bash-block-depth tracker (Python) to locate each gate's exact if/fi span for mechanical wrapping
approaches_tried.reason: Initial naive stripped-token match ('done'/'fi' as exact full-line match) failed to decrement depth for 'done < <(...)' lines carrying trailing redirection text; fixed by matching on a leading-word regex (^done\b, ^fi\b) instead of exact equality.

approaches_tried.approach: Run the full-battery before/after on an un-redeployed source-store edit expecting byte-identical output
approaches_tried.reason: A full-battery comparison against a pre-task baseline is not meaningful right now: gates 3/5 (manifest-driven content-drift / provides.scripts checks) and several gate8 suites report accumulating pre-redeploy drift from EVERY phase's new/modified files (1-4 included), which is expected and explicitly deferred to Phase 11's deploy-headless.sh run, not a regression. Switched to a scoped --only-gate 9-23 before/after comparison (unaffected by deploy drift, since gates 3/5 are outside that range) for the clean, meaningful proof of this phase's own transformation, plus root-caused every full-battery FAIL line to a pre-existing or deploy-lag cause (see Key Decisions in the phase handoff).

deviations.description: Capture the complete battery's output before and after with an explicit source-store TARGET; require identical finding sets and identical exit code.
deviations.reason: A byte-diff of the full battery against a pre-task baseline is not meaningful mid-task: undeployed source-store edits from every phase since Phase 1 (not just this phase) legitimately show up as gate3/gate5 drift findings until Phase 11's redeploy. Substituted a scoped --only-gate 9-23 before/after (clean, unaffected by deploy drift) plus one full-battery capture with every FAIL line root-caused to a pre-existing or deploy-lag cause, documented inline in the plan's own Phase 5 task-7 line.
deviations.annotation: *(completed with a scope correction, recorded as a deviation)*
